subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Monsanto oxidative addition product（[RhMe(I)₃(CO)₂]⁻）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal planar
D. Tetrahedral
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Rh (group 9) 9 e; 1 × Me (X) 1 e; 2 × CO (L) 4 e; 3 × I (X) 3 e; the 1− charge adds 1 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −4 in all and the complex has a 1− charge, so the metal is Rh(III), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e.
